title: Localizing a ring along a closed profinite subset produces a w-local ring with that set as its closed points
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a ring A and a closed subset V(I) of its spectrum which is profinite, there is an ind-Zariski ring map A -> B with Spec(B) w-local, closed point set V(IB) and A/I isomorphic to B/IB (statement lines 1011-1017). The proof (proof lines 1019-1031) takes the inverse image of V(I) in the closed points of the w-localization, localizes along it, and concludes the isomorphism from faithfulness of local isomorphisms. H2: a three-step construction with three inputs, written out in full.
